description: This file implements a sample application for rendering multi-textured objects using OpenGL ES 2.0. It defines a class MultiTextureSample that loads textures, compiles shaders, and renders a textured quad with two textures blended together.

classes.name: MultiTextureSample
classes.description: A sample application class that demonstrates multi-texture rendering with OpenGL ES 2.0.

methods.name: loadTexture
methods.description: Loads a TGA texture from a file path and returns its texture ID.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up shaders, loads textures, and prepares the rendering program.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up OpenGL resources such as shaders and textures.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders a textured quad with two blended textures.
